signature.name: VTask.restrictScalarsCongr
signature.type: {R : Type u₁} -> {S : Type u₂} -> [Ring R] -> [Ring S] -> {f g : R →+* S} -> (e : f = g) -> ModuleCat.restrictScalars f ≅ ModuleCat.restrictScalars g

conventions.statement: When e is rfl, the natural isomorphism VTask.restrictScalarsCongr rfl is the identity natural isomorphism on ModuleCat.restrictScalars f.
conventions.note: The construction reduces to the identity because the scalar actions are definitionally equal.

facts.statement: ∀ {R : Type*} {S : Type*} [Ring R] [Ring S] {f g : R →+* S} (e : f = g) (X : ModuleCat S), CategoryTheory.IsIso ((VTask.restrictScalarsCongr e).hom.app X)
